हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Maharani, the substitute bride, is a political family drama set against the backdrop of dynastic Indian politics. The series explores how women, often treated as pawns in the game of power, can become players who change the very rules of the game. At its heart, the story is a love story born out of compulsion, evolving into a political partnership of equals. Through betrayal, corruption, and power struggles, Anandi and Arjun’s journey reflects themes of loyalty. Watch Now.
